body:
Modpack for friends to play on together. The modpack design leans towards kitchensink, but primarily has en emphasis on a variety of magic mods, Create, and social mods.

## Tech
Included are Create and Create:Aeronautics, as well as a whole load of create addons. There is also Mekanism and CC: Tweaked for a little bit of tech variety.

## Magic
For Magic there are a few, including Ars, Malum, PSI, and Enchanted: Witchcraft.

## Exploration
I also tailored the pack around transporation and socialization, so there are no waystones to cheat transportation to encentivize things like Create Aeronautics. 

## Socialization
There is also Simple Voice Chat for socialization, including walkie talkies for long distance, as well as Envelope for long distance of sending packages to people. There are also some more fun mods with different toys to play with, like Exposure and a few addons like Exposure: Extended, Polaroid, Detective, and Space.
